newsitem.title: USA: Georgia gains 21,600 jobs in May - report.
newsitem.headline: Georgia gains 21,600 jobs in May - report.

text.p: Georgia added 21,600 jobs in May, putting the nonfarm employment total at 3.59 million, state Labor Commissioner David Poythress said.

Business services, including private employment agencies, saw the biggest gain, adding almost 7,000 jobs. Wholesalers and retailers added 4,900, including 2,100 seasonal jobs at amusement parks and recreation centers and 2,000 at restaurants.
Manufacturing added 1,500 jobs, transportation gained 1,100 jobs and construction added 700.
More than half of the new jobs, 11,400, were in the metropolitan Atlanta area.
